description: A gamified mental math app for kids with timed challenges, difficulty levels, streaks, and fun animations

features.description: MathProblem model with Operation enum (add, subtract, multiply, divide) and answer validation
test_steps: Create a MathProblem with two operands and an operation
Verify correctAnswer computes correctly for each operation
Verify isCorrect(answer:) returns true/false appropriately

features.description: DifficultyLevel enum (easy/medium/hard) with number ranges and operation sets per level
test_steps: Easy: operands 1-10, only add/subtract
Medium: operands 1-20, add/subtract/multiply
Hard: operands 1-50, all four operations
Each level has a time limit (easy=60s, medium=45s, hard=30s)

features.description: GameSession model tracking problems answered, score, time remaining, and session state
test_steps: GameSession starts with a difficulty and tracks score
Records correct and incorrect answers
Tracks current streak within a session
Calculates accuracy percentage

features.description: PlayerStats model for persistent progress tracking with daily streaks
test_steps: Tracks totalProblemssolved, totalCorrect, bestStreak
Tracks dailyStreak and lastPlayedDate
Daily streak increments when playing on consecutive days
Daily streak resets when a day is missed

features.description: ProblemGenerator service that creates random MathProblems based on difficulty level
test_steps: Generates problems within the operand range for the given difficulty
Only uses operations allowed for the given difficulty
Division problems always have clean integer answers
Subtraction on easy never produces negative results

features.description: GameEngine manages game flow: timer countdown, problem progression, scoring
test_steps: Starts a game session with selected difficulty
Provides current problem and accepts answers
Awards points for correct answers (bonus for speed)
Ends game when timer expires
Tracks session streak

features.description: StatsService persists and retrieves PlayerStats using SwiftData
test_steps: Saves game results to persistent storage
Retrieves current player stats
Updates daily streak correctly based on date
Updates best streak when current streak exceeds it

features.description: Home screen with animated title, play button, difficulty selector, and quick stats summary
test_steps: Displays app title with playful styling
Shows a prominent Play button
Displays difficulty picker (easy/medium/hard)
Shows current daily streak and total problems solved

features.description: Game screen showing current problem, answer input via number buttons, timer bar, and score
test_steps: Displays the math problem in large, kid-friendly text
Shows a number pad for input (0-9, delete, submit)
Animated timer bar counts down
Shows current score and streak counter
Answer field clears after submission

features.description: Celebration animations: confetti burst and star particles on correct answers, shake on wrong
test_steps: Correct answer triggers confetti/star animation
Wrong answer triggers a gentle shake animation
Streak milestones (5, 10, 15) trigger extra-large celebration
Animations don't block the next problem

features.description: Results screen after game ends showing score, accuracy, streak, and play-again button
test_steps: Shows final score with animated count-up
Displays accuracy percentage
Shows problems answered and best streak for the session
Has Play Again and Home buttons
Shows new record badge if best score beaten

features.description: Stats/progress screen with streak calendar, lifetime stats, and per-difficulty breakdown
test_steps: Shows current daily streak with flame icon
Displays lifetime stats (total solved, accuracy, best streak)
Shows a weekly activity indicator
Per-difficulty stats breakdown

features.description: App navigation with tab bar (Play, Stats) and game flow navigation
test_steps: Tab bar with Play and Stats tabs
Play tab navigates: Home -> Game -> Results -> Home
Stats tab shows the stats screen
Navigation state resets properly between games

features.description: Haptic feedback on correct/wrong answers and button taps for tactile game feel
test_steps: Correct answer triggers success haptic (notification success)
Wrong answer triggers error haptic (notification error)
Streak milestones trigger heavy impact haptic
Number pad buttons trigger light impact haptic

features.description: Animated countdown (3-2-1-GO!) before game starts to build anticipation
test_steps: After tapping Play, a 3-2-1-GO countdown overlay appears
Each number scales up and fades with spring animation
Game timer starts only after countdown finishes
Countdown uses large bold rounded font

features.description: Animated score popup (+10, +20, +30) that floats up when points are earned
test_steps: Correct answer shows floating +N points text
Points text animates upward and fades out
Bonus points show separately (e.g. +5 speed bonus)
Animation doesn't block gameplay

features.description: Achievement/badge model with unlockable milestones for gamification
test_steps: Achievement has id, title, description, emoji, and requirement
Check if an achievement is unlocked based on PlayerStats
Predefined achievements: First Game, Streak Master (10), Speed Demon (hard mode), Century (100 solved), Perfect Round (100% accuracy with 10+ answers)

features.description: Achievements screen showing earned and locked badges in a grid
test_steps: Shows grid of achievement badges
Unlocked achievements show colored emoji and title
Locked achievements appear grayed out with lock icon
Achievement count shown in header (e.g. 2/8 unlocked)
Accessible from Stats tab

features.description: Achievement unlock toast notification that slides in when a new badge is earned
test_steps: When a new achievement is unlocked after a game, toast appears on results screen
Toast shows achievement emoji, title, and description
Toast slides in from top with animation
Toast auto-dismisses after 3 seconds
